mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 3.6% triggers labor market strengthening, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in GDPC1 (demand) indicate expansionary monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% and GDPC1 rises >2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not outperform baseline when both FEDFUNDS falls and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a downward shift in UNRATE below 3.4% suggests weakening labor demand, contraction in corporate profits, and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls >0.2pp in 1 month during late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE falling >0.2pp in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in INDPRO (supply) reflects increased production capacity and reduced inflationary pressures, fostering market optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in PAYEMS above 150,000 indicates strong labor demand, spurring corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses the 10,000 threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in HOUST (demand) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, lifting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% and HOUST rises >500 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not outperform baseline when both FEDFUNDS falls and HOUST rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sharp rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% anticipates higher interest rates, reducing growth expectations and causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% in 1 month during monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% in a tightening cycle.
